packageRules.description: Rollback PRs should not be subject to minimum release age
Do not apply minimum release age to qlik-oss packages by package name
Do not apply minimum release age to qlik-oss packages by source URL
Do not require minimum release age for lock file maintenance
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Renovate lock file maintenance does not validate minimum release age because the package manager performs the required updates.

packageRules.description: Do not require minimum release age for package replacements
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Renovate replacement updates do not currently wire package release age into checks, so minimum release age must be validated manually.

packageRules.description: Do not require minimum release age for package pinning
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Renovate pin updates do not currently wire package release age into checks, so minimum release age must be validated manually.

packageRules.description: Do not require minimum release age for digest updates
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Renovate digest updates may not reliably provide release age checks, so minimum release age is disabled for these updates.
